capabilities: Critiques explanations and identifies understanding gaps
Designs transfer-practice tasks for real work
Records observer feedback and next learning targets
Provides local prompts and learning-session notes in Obsidian
extras: The core product is an Agent Skill; the Obsidian plugin is optional, does not call AI, read Copilot settings, collect telemetry, or make network requests. The public version excludes private project content.
motivation: AI should not read instead of you; it should help you explain ideas, use them in real work, and turn practice into ability.
problem: Reading and summarizing produce notes but not usable understanding, because ideas are not reconstructed, corrected, transferred, and fed back into practice.

requires.name: AI agent host that supports skills

summary: AI learning-coach skill and optional Obsidian plugin that turns reading into active recall, critique, and real-task practice.
